entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Sales', 'Support', or 'Returns'.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi... I think I need to return something? I bought some shoes, and I'm just so confused by the whole process.
I can certainly help you look into that. Do you have your order number handy?
Umm, let me see... yes, it's VF88602. I just... I don't know if I'm doing it right.

Thank you. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the Mountain Bike Shoes, delivered about 60 days ago. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the cycling shoes?

They just don't feel right. I think I got blisters from my last ride. And the part where the cleats attach feels really stiff. I just want a refund, but the website was so overwhelming. Can't you just help me?
I'm very sorry to hear they're causing you blisters and aren't working out. I can absolutely help you with this, no problem at all. Let me just confirm the return policy for you.
Okay, I've checked your order, and since it was delivered 60 days ago, it's still well within our 90-day return window.
Oh! It is? I couldn't figure that out. So I can send them back?

Yes, absolutely. I have just authorized the return for you. I am sending an email to you right now that contains a pre-paid shipping label and instructions. You just need to print the label, put the shoes back in the box, and drop it off at a post office. Once our warehouse receives it, your full refund will be processed.
Wow, okay. That's so much easier. Thank you so much for your help.
You're very welcome. I'm happy I could get that sorted out for you. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's it. Thank you, Alex.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
